meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 让所选 NanoClaw 代理组里的代理获得两个无需 API key 的 Tavily 工具:联网搜索(tavily_search)与网页内容提取(tavily_extract);当无密钥配额耗尽时,代理会主动提供升级到付费 API key 的指引。
howto.when: 当用户要求为某个 NanoClaw 代理组安装无需 API key 的 Tavily 联网搜索或网址内容提取时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 分组装不用 key 的 Tavily 搜索和提取
say.note: 会注册两个远程 MCP 工具。

say.text: 给我的分组用 keyless 方式配 Tavily,只要搜索和提取
Tavily 无 key 配额用完时,帮我加好升级到付费 key 的指引
say.note: 会写入升级说明并给出预填好的链接。

howto.what_en: Gives the agents in selected NanoClaw groups two Tavily tools without an API key: tavily_search for web search and tavily_extract for web content extraction. When the keyless quota runs out, the agent offers a paid-key upgrade path.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install Tavily web search or URL extraction for a NanoClaw agent group without an API key.

say_en.text: Help me install keyless Tavily search and extract for a NanoClaw group
say_en.note: Registers the two remote MCP tools.

say_en.text: Configure Tavily for my group in keyless mode, keeping only search and extract
Set up the paid-key upgrade guide for when Tavily's keyless quota runs out
say_en.note: Adds the guide and a prefilled dashboard link.
